# Psychology — Formation, Symbolic Transformation and the Return of Responsibility

## #0 — A person acts within formations they did not consciously choose

The protected [Psychology history](HISTORY.md) **grounds** this development in a particular question: how do formations beyond conscious intention organise attention, affect and action, and how can their organisation become answerable? Its route passes through collective psychology, analytical psychology, psychoanalysis, cultural histories of consciousness and contemporary agent design. These are intersecting inquiries with different objects and methods. Their sequence here follows changes in the question, without asserting that one school historically culminates in the next.

The distinction between formation and aggregate begins the route. A crowd can act differently from its members considered separately. A complex can orient a person's responses before deliberation. A signifying relation can exceed a speaker's intended message. An institution can preserve authority across changing incumbents. Each case requires its own account of what persists, what changes and who can answer. Calling them all a psyche would erase the institutional and material differences the history needs to disclose.

The [Arbitration whole-field](../../../etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD.md) **grounds** the authorial relation carried through this inquiry. Continuity-in-Indeterminacy lets a formation have a history without exhausting its conditions; Criterion-through-Distinction and Delineation-through-Difference make its selecting measure and frame determinate; Arbitration-in-Crisis gives the selection consequence; Con-text-through-Diaphaneity lets excluded conditions bear on it; Resolution-in-Reconciliation returns its achievement with its provenance active. The semantic flowering of the last relation is Anamnesis / Recognition / Return. These generated operations retain their exact offices. The history supplies psychological and institutional witnesses; it does not derive the field from Greek or Latin word histories.

## #1 — Collective formation acquires a political apparatus

In the selected 1895 English edition of [Le Bon's *The Crowd*](../../../sources/psychology/le-bon/le-bon-1895-crowd-popular-mind/le-bon-1895-crowd-popular-mind.md), book I, chapter 1 **historicises** a psychological crowd as a formation rather than a count. A common influence can organise people without their physical assembly, and their combination can produce characteristics absent from each person in isolation. That formulation makes distributed formation intelligible before the present technical media through which it travels. The narrow relation does not inherit Le Bon's racial hierarchy or generalise his diagnosis to every collective undertaking.

The selected 2013 Hull translation of [Jung's *The Undiscovered Self*](../../../sources/psychology/jung/jung-2013-undiscovered-self-routledge/jung-2013-undiscovered-self-routledge.md) **extends** the question from emergent formation to the person's diminished standing within it. Chapter 1, pp. 9–11, passes from the statistical abstraction to the negligible individual, then to transferred responsibility and the personification of the State. The stages have different consequences. Averaging makes a comparison possible; substituting the average for the person makes the concrete case disappear. Delegated responsibility can then relieve participants of the judgment through which an institution remains their undertaking. The apparently animate State conceals people able to operate its apparatus. This is Jung's diagnosis, preserved through the selected edition rather than redated to 2013 as an originating event.

Desmet's author-published [2022 web essay](../../../sources/psychology/desmet/desmet-2022-psychology-totalitarianism-web-essay/desmet-2022-psychology-totalitarianism-web-essay.md) **compares** a more specific affective sequence: isolation and loss of meaning leave anxiety and frustration available for binding to a narrative. The narrative's force includes its capacity to make contrary material inaccessible. An account of the world thus participates in organising the conditions under which it will next be believed. The source states Desmet's diagnosis, including the mass–elite relation; it does not establish a general law or diagnose a particular contemporary population for this history.

[Iakovou's review](../../../sources/political-theory-institutions/iakovou/iakovou-2022-misuse-totalitarianism/iakovou-2022-misuse-totalitarianism.md) **qualifies** that account by asking for political specificity. Her directly consulted [journal text](https://existenz.us/volumes/Vol.15-2Iakovou.html), paragraphs beginning “The concept designates” and “Several related critical aspects,” requires institutions, political forces and differences between forms of government. Her Arendt-mediated discussion names offices, secret police and camps; these cannot be replaced by a diffuse social mood. The displayed Fall 2020 issue date conflicts with the reviewed 2022 book, so bibliographic dating remains unresolved. The substantive criticism is recoverable without pretending that conflict has disappeared.

The resulting historical relation **returns-to** [A19's local arbitration regime](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime.md) with a limit on transfer. Both psychic fixation and institutional capture can protect a governing criterion from what it excludes. The mechanism and remedy differ: psychological recognition does not by itself redistribute an office's powers, remove coercion or establish a means of appeal. Conversely, changing a rule does not automatically change the affective investment that sustains its use. The history keeps their circuit visible.

## #2 — Symbolic totality changes the interpreter's place

[Aion's source house](../../../sources/psychology/jung/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2/jung-1978-aion-cw9-2.md) **sources** a different movement: the conscious ego encounters shadow, projection and symbolic totality. The consulted paperback's §§1–5 and 13–19 distinguish the conscious reference point from autonomous affect and the self-reinforcing isolation of projection. §§43–49 then qualify both directions of inflation: ego can appropriate the Self, while the Self's demands can overwhelm the ego's relative autonomy and worldly obligations. A larger image is therefore not automatically a better integration.

The [complete Aion whole](../../../../mytheme/worlds/analytical-psychology/jung-aion-fishes-christ-antichrist-alchemy/WHOLE.md) **historicises** the changing material through which Jung asks that question: Christ and Antichrist, fishes and astrological time, alchemical work, Gnostic comparisons, and the return of a transformed psychological account. Christian doctrine, ancient reported rites, medieval materials and modern reconstruction keep their separate tellings. Jung's insertion of a Shadow Quaternio in §§402–413 matters precisely as a modern act of interpretation. The diagram's circulation returns to consciousness with a changed relation; it cannot be treated as an unaltered ancient schema discovered intact. The house now has sixteen consulted passage maps and the actual local copy. The selected 1978 hardcover and consulted 1979 paperback remain distinct; quotation and selected-printing collation are separate tasks.

[Smythe's 2013 dialogical reading](../../../sources/psychology/smythe/smythe-2013-dialogical-jung/smythe-2013-dialogical-jung.md) **qualifies** the whole-forming relation through voices beyond ego control. His conclusion places the ego among autonomous positions and refuses to make the inner other an ordinary object fully available to truth-apt representation. This gives the history a precise change of method: a description of inner contents is insufficient if the describing position retains unquestioned sovereignty over what those contents can say. Smythe's account remains a scholarly interpretation of Jung.

[Neumann's source and protected encounter](../../../sources/psychology/neumann/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness/neumann-1954-origins-history-consciousness.md) **compares** the formation of a differentiated centre through separation, parental powers, transformation and centroversion. The common structuration lets a local centre receive more than it contains. It leaves each myth's geography, historical mediation and temporal order with that telling. Neumann's developmental morphology is not evidence that all peoples passed through one empirically demonstrated timetable. In the author's encounter, the marked paper and its enabling field give this relation a further native reading; Neumann does not originate QL's notation.

[A21 — Individuation / Recognition](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md) **returns-to** this history through differentiated indivisibility. Ego, complexes, archetypal capacities and the whole-forming office have different scopes. Recognition changes their relations while preserving this person's body, history and responsibility. Becoming undivided neither removes difference nor promotes a chief complex to the position of the whole. The project's positive operation is Argued; the separate provenance of any attributed “becoming indivisible” wording remains a source task.

## #3 — A dream, a mathematical expression and a speaking place

The 1932–1958 [Jung–Pauli correspondence](../../../sources/psychology/jung/jung-pauli-meier-2001-atom-archetype/jung-pauli-meier-2001-atom-archetype.md) **historicises** an exchange across disciplinary practices. Pauli's “Modern Examples of ‘Background Physics’,” Appendix 3, distinguishes physical concepts used qualitatively in dreams from quantitatively formulated physics. Fierz's Appendix 2 identifies the recovered text as an undated typescript or outline. Its unfinished character belongs to the historical object, rather than being a defect to conceal with a completed theory.

The [Pauli egg whole](../../../../mytheme/worlds/analytical-psychology/pauli-egg-dream/WHOLE.md) **figures** the passage with its seven pictures intact. A woman arrives with a bird; its egg divides spontaneously; Pauli notices another egg in his own hand and divides it; four eggs become a trigonometric arrangement and quotient; his final spoken recognition is followed by a circle. The pair of dreams occurred four days apart in mid-March, without a year supplied in this passage. Göttingen belongs to the companion dream, not the egg scene. The difference between spontaneous production and conscious participation gives the symbolic movement its historical particularity. The primary telling is now recovered in the Princeton-imprint reading carrier; equivalence to the house's selected Routledge 2001 edition remains uncollated.

[Atmanspacher's 2020 formulation](../../../sources/physics/atmanspacher/atmanspacher-2020-pauli-jung-conjecture/atmanspacher-2020-pauli-jung-conjecture.md) **compares** the conjecture through a psychophysically neutral basis from which mental and physical descriptions are distinguished. His speculative extension of quantum terminology is explicit. This is a later conceptual reconstruction, not the date or wording of the correspondence, and not an observed correlation. [Courtney's 2019 salt-point discussion](../../../sources/psychology/courtney/courtney-2019-salt-point-kairos-chaos/courtney-2019-salt-point-kairos-chaos.md) **qualifies** the neighbouring quaternity vocabulary: symbolic dynamism and the meaning of an opportune moment cannot be reduced to a physical mechanism by mentioning time crystals. Her nested Jung, Jacobi and Edinger references remain mediated.

A different scene of address occurs in Paris at Sainte-Anne, on 6 January 1972. [Lacan's *Talking to Brick Walls*](../../../sources/psychology/lacan/lacan-2017-talking-to-brick-walls/lacan-2017-talking-to-brick-walls.md) **historicises** the move from amphitheatre to chapel, the address to its walls, an audience interruption and the tuning of voice to reverberation. The currently source-matched Price passages at pp. 80–81 and 86 retain that material and responsive setting. The walls return speech in a way the speaker must hear; the audience remains implicated. [Adleman and Vanderwees's 2021 account](../../../sources/psychology/adleman/adleman-vanderwees-2021-lacan-rhetoric/adleman-vanderwees-2021-lacan-rhetoric.md) **qualifies** this through the analytic work of hearing one's own discourse and the simultaneous dividing and connecting effected by symbolic mediation.

[Darmon's 1992 dictionary entry](../../../sources/psychology/darmon/darmon-1992-matheme-ali/darmon-1992-matheme-ali.md) **sources** the distinct technical ambition of matheme: structural writing and transmission, including the stated transformation of Saussure's algorithm. This history does not collapse the wall scene into that definition. The movement **returns-to** [Homologia / Analogia](../../../etymologies/homology-and-analogy/WHOLE-FIELD.md): Pauli's mathematical dream, Lacan's formal ambition and Taylor's native `X/x` can meet through an explicitly stated relation while retaining different notation, methods and source claims. A shared bar or numeral supplies no historical identity.

## #4 — Dynamical and cultural accounts make context consequential

[Van Eenwyk's 1991 article](../../../sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1991-strange-attractors/van-eenwyk-1991-strange-attractors.md) and [1997 book](../../../sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors.md) **historicise** a later encounter between analytical psychology and nonlinear dynamics. The source houses identify the explanatory model but currently hold no gathered excerpts. Frank's protected book NOTES, pp. 65–73, develop a distinct authorial yield: archetypal dynamics, complexes as affective organisation, images as particular appearances and symbols as agents of transformation. The copied book and nested Freeman, Tillich and Jung quotations remain leads. Their source debt does not demote the authorial known→unknown→known movement.

[Taylor's Symbolon Dynamics](../../../sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics.md) **grounds** that movement in the native field. A symbol changes the organisation through which an interpreter receives an image; the changed interpreter then conditions the next encounter. Enough integrity must persist for the encounter to have a bearer, and enough openness must remain for its effect to change that bearing. Neither disintegration nor rigid restoration supplies the only measure of change. The native `x→X→x` retains a particular on return; real local Bimba originality remains effective while itself standing within a further source/appearance relation.

[Daza and colleagues' 2016 basin definition](../../../sources/mathematics-logic/daza/daza-et-al-2016-basin-entropy/daza-et-al-2016-basin-entropy.md) **qualifies** technical use. Initial conditions lead a specified dynamical system toward an attractor; open Hamiltonian escape basins require a different treatment from dissipative attraction. A psychological model claiming that exact technical identity must specify its dynamics, state space and observables. This requirement sharpens a scientific claim; it leaves the Argued symbolic operation intact. The history therefore preserves the difference between explanatory analogy and a measured dynamical result.

[Gebser's *The Ever-Present Origin*](../../../sources/phenomenology-continental-philosophy/gebser/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin/gebser-1985-ever-present-origin.md) **historicises** another way context becomes consequential. Its mapped pp. 11–21 place Giotto, Petrarch, Alberti and Leonardo in an account of depth, landscape and perspective; pp. 24–28 and 470–86 turn to the disclosure of time and multiple aspects in later painting. Its method reads changes in consciousness through the means by which a world becomes visible. Aperspectivity makes perspective's conditions available while retaining its capacities. It does not erase the observer's achieved placement or assimilate all artistic histories to a single psychological experiment.

Their relation **returns-to** [Symbol / Account / Trust](../../../etymologies/symbol-account-and-trust/WHOLE-FIELD.md) through its four exact operations. Symbol answers to source; Account does not replace source; Trust keeps the return route active; Account re-enters source-field. An interpretation can affect the world in which it will next appear convincing. Integrity requires that its effects remain able to alter its criteria. The historical and relational branches of E2, E4 and E5 retain their lexical evidence separately from this psychological continuation.

## #5→0 — Provisional agency returns the institutional question

[Agentworld](../../../sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md) **extends** the contemporary question through a design-research carrier dated June 2026. At pp. 13–14, performed subjectivity and functional agency are distinguished without settling what intentionality a model has. Active context individuates an agent from prior capacities; persona is one layer among skills, memory, teleological constraints and relational infrastructure. The actual local transcription's §2.5 adds the collective's individuation through the agent, making the relation constitutive rather than a surrounding backdrop. This is the brief's account and proposed milieu, with its p. 53 scenario modality retained.

The historical return is exact: a coherent persona cannot establish that its criterion is answerable, just as an effective collective cannot establish that its members retain responsibility. At pp. 35–36, institutional intelligence belongs to rules, roles and procedures, and cultural differences remain consequential. The authorial continuation asks which encounter can revise a source, interpretation, evaluator or commission. A second use has to show what changed and what history it retained. This is an Offered technical test, not evidence that a described architecture has already performed it.

[The embodied-cognition entry](../../../sources/analytic-philosophy/wilson/wilson-et-al-2020-embodied-cognition-sep/wilson-et-al-2020-embodied-cognition-sep.md) **qualifies** the comparison through organism, sensorimotor activity and environment; [Tye's qualia entry](../../../sources/analytic-philosophy/tye/tye-2024-qualia-sep/tye-2024-qualia-sep.md) **qualifies** the distinct question of phenomenal character. Inspectable context is operationally consequential, while whether an artificial system has experience remains Open. That boundary neither denies the system's actual causal participation nor replaces the essay's independently Argued order of dependence with uncertainty about every form of subjectivity.

This development **returns-to** [A21](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A21-Individuation-Recognition.md) with recognition's achieved history and **qualifies** [A20's image, valuation and possession](../../../../../section-rooms/arguments/A20-Image-Valuation-Possession.md) through the conditions under which a representation shapes its next encounter. It also **returns-to** the protected [Psychology history](HISTORY.md), preserving its crowd→complex→psychoid→signification→cultural-context→agent-world movement. Source gaps remain specific: primary Van Eenwyk and nested authors; direct Lacan edition collation; selected Jung/Pauli printings; Iakovou's journal dating; any claimed therapeutic, institutional or computational outcome. None converts the established authorial operation into a merely possible neighbouring thesis.
